description: `retrieval.status` reports availability, PER-CORPUS staleness (O4: code churns and history does not — two figures, never one global number), and the embedding identity, through the identical function `aeon index status` calls (D15/P34). It starts nothing: a status read that reindexed is the auto-fire V21 forbids. `reindexing` with `percent` 0 means running with no figure yet — 'running' and '0%' are different claims.
